name: common-lab
description: Unified opt-in laboratory: 22 experimental skills: delegation, TypeSafe Jev basics (a request router, setup, gate, pick, score, finding Jev opportunities, Jev-assisted browser debugging, a stop check, an ask-the-user check), and Jev overlays on define-goal, strategic-advance, delegate, contract, seal, review, think, ui, show-me, wait-what, wayfinder, and cold-estimation. Plus one Claude Code mod: recall (type @@ to pull a past conversation into the prompt).
